facts.fact: 第一篇作业今天下午 5 点出分，Eden 焦虑到在 Gemma 房里来回踱步抠指甲。
facts.anchor: I don’t think I’ve ever been more anxious for an assignment mark before.

facts.fact: 视频接通时 Oliver 光膀子满脸汗、气喘吁吁，Eden 与 Gemma 同时怀疑他正和别人在一起。
报出 93 分后 Oliver 大笑祝贺，一句「I'm so proud of you」让她全身发热。
facts.anchor: My whole-body flushes with heat when he says that.

facts.fact: Ben 乱入镜头道贺，被 Oliver 一句轰回沙袋——两兄弟随即爆发拳击手套大战。
facts.anchor: Leave us alone and go back to your punching bag.

facts.fact: Gemma 主张借 1920's ball 灌酒下手，Eden 拒绝：不会用灌酒勾引家教，有更有底线的方式。
facts.anchor: I’m not going to seduce my tutor by getting him drunk. There’s more ethical ways than that.

facts.fact: Eden 的邀请短信把 Gemma 写成醉鬼笑料，Gemma 控诉她为了男人出卖朋友。
facts.anchor: Jesus, you really threw me under the bus. And all for a man?

facts.fact: 走廊 Gatsby 猜谜最后 Oliver 一句「Good girl」，Eden 脑内连宕四拍、原文四连重复后直接爆粗。
Oliver 借问洗手间路过时按了一下她的胯，那块皮肤当场烧起来。
facts.anchor: He presses a gentle hand into my hip as he passes, nodding thanks.
